'first' (often not a count; check): "Israel's allied pick, its first upstream or midstream sector on the Strategic Index after a resource-base screen, is midstream solar."

150 words: "Scores compare Israel with other economies in the same sector; they are not measures of risk or profit in absolute terms. All index values are the paper's baseline as of 12 October 2026; Strategic Insights recomputes them under other weightings. Some of Israel's sectors are not placed: a score is compared with other economies only when the economy is sovereign and at most half of the score rests on filled-in data. The Climate Action Tracker does not rate Israel, so its policy activity rests on International Energy Agency Policies and Measures records alone; its policy levels compare only with economies on the same basis. Strategic Index scores within 0.01 of each other are almost tied: small changes in the data or the weights can swap their order. Many allied picks are close calls: in the paper, 37% of them are within 0.01 of the runner-up. Country Insights shows the detail."
